# datadog_integration_elastic_cloud_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog Elastic Cloud integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the Elastic Cloud integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Elastic Cloud integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the Elastic Cloud integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from Elastic Cloud, keyed by dataflow id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `elastic_cloud_integration_account_basic_auth` (Attributes) The basic authentication method and username configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--elastic_cloud_integration_account_basic_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--elastic_cloud_integration_account_basic_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.elastic_cloud_integration_account_basic_auth`

Required:

- `password_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret password or private key. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for password_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.
- `username` (String) Non-secret username or public identifier for the credential pair.

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `basic`. Defaults to `"basic"`.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `url` (String) Elastic Cloud deployment URL.

Optional:

- `tags` (String) Comma-separated list of custom tags for this Elastic Cloud deployment.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `elastic_cloud_detailed_index_stats` (Attributes) Primary shard metrics broken down per index, rather than aggregated across the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--elastic_cloud_detailed_index_stats))
- `elastic_cloud_index_stats` (Attributes) Metrics for individual indices. Only the indices granted to the role of the user in `authentication` are collected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--elastic_cloud_index_stats))
- `elastic_cloud_pending_task_stats` (Attributes) Metrics for cluster-level changes that have been submitted but not yet executed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--elastic_cloud_pending_task_stats))
- `elastic_cloud_primary_shard_graceful_timeout` (Attributes) Tolerance for slow primary shard requests, keeping the rest of the collection running when a primary shard request times out instead of failing the run. Only has an effect alongside `elastic-cloud-primary-shard-stats`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--elastic_cloud_primary_shard_graceful_timeout))
- `elastic_cloud_primary_shard_stats` (Attributes) Metrics covering only the cluster's primary shards. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--elastic_cloud_primary_shard_stats))
- `elastic_cloud_shard_allocation_stats` (Attributes) Metrics for how many shards are allocated to each data node, and the disk space they use. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--elastic_cloud_shard_allocation_stats))
- `elastic_cloud_slm_stats` (Attributes) Metrics about the actions taken by snapshot lifecycle management. Requires the `read_slm` Elasticsearch cluster privilege on the role of the user in `authentication`; without it this dataflow collects no data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--elastic_cloud_slm_stats))

Read-Only:

- `elastic_cloud_metrics` (Attributes) Node-level statistics for the clusters in your deployment, such as the number of nodes and the number of documents on each node. This is the integration's baseline collection: it is always on and cannot be turned off, which is why it appears in responses only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--elastic_cloud_metrics))

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.

Read-Only:

- `status` (Attributes) Read-only collection status of a dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--elastic_cloud_detailed_index_stats--status))

### Nested Schema for `dataflows.elastic_cloud_detailed_index_stats.status`

Read-Only:

- `updated_at` (String) Time the status was last computed.
